run_upload_diff_to_codereview: run upload.py to upload diffs from git, mercurial, or subversion to the codereview app
run_GuessVCS: run GuessVCS to detect which version control system is active in the current directory
run_SplitPatch: run SplitPatch to split an svn diff output into separate patches per file
run_EncodeMultipartFormData: run EncodeMultipartFormData to encode form fields and files into multipart/form-data for HTTP upload
run_RunShellWithReturnCode: run RunShellWithReturnCode to execute a shell command and capture stdout output and return code
